_fixture.purpose: Expected outcomes for the pure Sysselraad evaluator of milestone M4 (not implemented in M1) and for the board geometry; nothing here is a game save.

ownersNotation.?: owner not readable from the row

_fixture.boardIndex: board_index = 5 * row + column, rows and columns 0..4; owners strings list board_index 0..24 in order
_fixture.houseNames: DEMO_HOUSE_NN are made up and are never shown by the production page
_fixture.tasks: A case with no tasks list has one task per owners letter: board_index = its position, completed and winning_faction_id from the letter (A: 1 and 1, H: 1 and 2, O: 0 and NULL, ?: 1 and NULL). A case with a tasks list gives the rows as the save holds them.
_fixture.verdictRules: See 04-fixture-catalog.md, section "Verdict rules the cases encode". They are proposals for the M4 review, not shipped behaviour.
